roads.name: Cordova Pass Road
words: Curve after curve after curve: 50 in 4.6 miles, about 11 a mile.
Tight and technical: most curves turn on a radius under 130 ft.
From 9,671 to 11,090 ft, with 1,467 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 72°F.
Partly paved.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 30 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.49 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
